core_obligations: Supply the complete six-condition class and both cofinality and amalgamation constructions, not just named proof630

proof_roadmap: Realize branch points as the Fraisse limit of finite positive-type betweenness structures.
Prove JEP through fixed-branch-point extensions and patchwork.
Construct a cofinal subclass with controlled periodic and austro-boreal orbit data.
Amalgamate systems by separating orbit cases and patching their dendrite realizations.
difficulty_reason: H3: the proof builds a cofinal class of finite partial automorphisms with six coupled orbit/median conditions, proves cofinality by multi-case reductions and induction, and proves amalgamation through detailed periodic/nonperiodic orbit gluings in a dendrite. The nonroutine local core is fully supplied. The final one-line Truss invocation alone is not treated as the proof.
